post.caption: On November 8, 1958, Harry Winston mailed the Hope Diamond from New York to the Smithsonian in Washington. It went by registered first class mail, wrapped in brown paper. Postage was only $2.44, the rest of the $145.29 bill was insurance for $1 million, and the package weighed 61 ounces with its packing. Letter carrier James Todd delivered it on November 10, and it became the cornerstone of the National Gem Collection.
